response.overview: The story follows Zaraa (Emma Maeombong) who marries Haris (Keith Foo) based on love and the dream of having a happy family. However, after marriage, Zaraa realizes that her husband is a "mama's boy". Their married life is constantly interfered with by Haris's mother, Mak Leha, who is always her husband's priority. The conflict escalates when Haris fails to act fairly in dividing responsibilities and affection between his mother and wife, and there is also a condition for them to live under the same roof with his mother-in-law. When all of Zaraa's sacrifices go unappreciated, she is forced to make a major choice between wanting to preserve her love or protect her own dignity.
response.title: Suamiku Anak Mak
